report.name: Liaoning Normal University (LNNU)
report.description: Liaoning Normal University (LNNU) and Missouri State University (MSU) created the LNNU-MSU College of International Business (CIB) in 2000. Once enrolled, students have a few degree track options. The first two years of our program lead to an Associate of Arts (AA) degree in General Studies from Missouri State University. Students wishing to complete their Bachelor's degree then have two main options. These students can either continue studying at Dalian for Bachelor of Science in General Business or they can go Missouri State Springfield to finish the last two years of study.
